banner.title: The Dragon promotion batch one - the pre-walk trio and issue 2 complete
banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round four, the first rules promotion batch under the R968 format: eight records promoted mechanically from their spec JSONs into content/rules/dragon/ - the pre-walk trio (ivs, drg, arn) and issue 2 complete (rmz, alc, fch, sys, art), 281 model items, every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof). The batch sizing rides byte weight, not record counts. THE R968 CORRECTION rides here: the rpfDragonSpecs 128 was a grep over-match (WSG, OA, DMO, MM2, DDG and FF specs and self-references caught by the word Dragon) - the walked Dragon set is R887 through R965, 79 rounds, all with models; the R632 measure-twice class.
